capabilities.why: Safety hooks inspect and intercept dangerous agent commands before they reach the guest kernel, blocking malicious payload execution, credential exfiltration, and unauthorized privilege escalation in real time.

Hardware-enforced network policy isolates the microVM from outbound internet access by default, preventing prompt-injected exfiltration payloads from leaking environment variables or sensitive files to external command-and-control servers.

MicroVM point-in-time snapshots capture complete CPU, memory, and filesystem state before risky execution steps, allowing sub-second rollback to a verified clean baseline when step 7 of 10 encounters mid-task failure without requiring a cold reboot.
